name: Avià (Spain)
description: Blue field with a yellow saltire throughout, the arms one ninth of the height in width.
history: The flag was approved on 9 March 1994 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1874 of 18 March 1994; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, blue, with a yellow saltire throughout whose arms are 1/9 of the height of the flag.

features.role: saltire with arms 1/9 of the height
